items.title: Bazi90 - Sport venues booking and much more
items.description: Bazi90 is a sports venue booking and management platform that connects players with sports facilities, making it easy to discover venues, book playing sessions, organize matches, and manage reservations. It simplifies sports facility management while creating a more accessible and connected sports community in Afghanistan.

items.title: Unity Contruction Management System
items.description: Unity Construction is a modern construction management and ERP platform designed to streamline construction projects, tenders, procurement, workforce management, budgeting, and project operations. It helps construction companies manage resources, improve collaboration, and maintain control over every stage of their projects.

items.title: Unity Learning Management System
items.description: UnityLearn a customized Learning Management System (LMS) designed to deliver a modern, scalable online learning experience. The platform extends the core LearnHouse capabilities with tailored learning workflows, course and content management, student and instructor management, assessments, progress tracking, and interactive learning experiences. It aims to make quality education more accessible while providing institutions with the tools to manage and scale their digital learning environments.
